episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses strategies for leveraging past clients with low interest rates by turning properties into rental investments. He explains the benefits of bridge loans and HELOCs for accessing home equity and facilitating new property purchases. The episode also explores how AI is streamlining the loan process, offering practical insights for real estate agents to grow their business.
